name: gtc_10p4m
label: Gran Telescopio Canarias 10.4 m
sources: gtc.iac.es: 10.4 m segmented primary (36 hexagonal segments), 28 45 24 N, 17 53 31 W, about 2300 m; Wikipedia: collecting area 78.54 m^2, altitude 2267 m
notes: Throughput 0.3 (atmosphere + telescope optics to the camera, excl. filter and PDE) is the hbtsim default, not an LPQI number; Prada et al. 2026 (ELTI) adopt an overall instrumental efficiency of 0.5 for a SPAD camera at the focus.
GTC FITS headers carry the INT's coordinates (LATITUDE +28:45:43.2, LONGITUD +17:52:39.5) and are not a GTC position.
